## Checklist

- [ ] Linked to an issue (unless it's a typo fix)
- [ ] No game files, executables or extracted game resources
- [ ] No decompiled or disassembled game code, and no IDA, Ghidra or Binary Ninja databases
- [ ] No IP addresses, Steam or Epic user IDs or account names in code, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Roadmap updated if this changes a decision, estimate, risk or spike result
- [ ] For code: incoming network messages are checked for size, range and unknown entity IDs before use
